text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, we've reached the final stretch! 
Which Umamusume will seize the title of 
the world's strongest!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Like I'd ever give it up! Hyaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! The climax starts right here! 
—Daaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaahhhhh—!! —Ahahahaha!!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(I feel it! I feel it! It's irresistible! 
Air Groove's dazzling Marvelous, and 
Fuji's sparkling Marvelous!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(I never could have predicted either of 
them! They're so dazzling! They're both so 
amazing!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: This is so, SO— MARRRRVELLLLOOOOUUUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday... That girl, has she 
gotten endlessly stronger?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There's even a rumor going around 
among the fans that "running with that 
girl makes you stronger"—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I think it's because 
running with Marvelous helps her remember 
"the joy of running."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well—that's how everything goes, I 
suppose. Following one's own heart's 
desire. In the end, the ones who can 
achieve things while having fun are the 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right? And, assuming that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha☆ Was everyone marvelous!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
As for me, it was so, so very! 
Maaaaaaarvelous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"She who can create such joy is always, 
more than anyone else, having the most fun 
running—having the most fun racing."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's why――she's so strong, I bet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the cheers that echoed endlessly, 
Marvelous Sunday burst into a radiant 
smile that shone brighter than anyone 
else's...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(The Marvelous I shared will grow inside 
everyone, becoming an even greater 
Marvelous!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(And—when I feel that, I can spread an 
even bigger, bigger, MUCH bigger 
Marvelous!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Convey it. Connect. Grow bigger. It comes 
back. Grows even bigger. And reaches them! 
Wider and stronger than ever!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so—that was it☆ The one and only 
marvelous way to make the world 
marvelous—★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That・would・be—☆★☆
